title: Racing the fastest Lambos vs the fastest Tesla! ⚡️

author: carwow
description:

Can a £52,000 electric SUV actually take down a Lamborghini? We’re finding out today in a massive Lambo vs EV drag race!

Mat’s behind the wheel of the Smart #5 Brabus, and it’s punching way above its weight class. But does it really stand a chance racing up the Carwow drag race strip? Let’s check out the other contenders. 

First up it’s going head-to-head with a Lamborghini Huracán Performante. It packs a 5.2-litre naturally-aspirated V10 with 640hp and 600Nm. It weighs a tiny 1,482kg - nearly a tonne less than the Smart! It’s also more than 3x the price, costing around £185,000.

The next contender will be the Lamborghini Aventador SVJ.  It’s equipped with a 6.5-litre NA V12, and this creates 770hp and 720Nm. Power is sent to all four wheels via a single-clutch 7-speed gearbox, and it costs an eye-watering £450,000!
